I won't be able to make any games today, however I am pleased to announce that I have finished the spreadie!

I'm not going to guarantee that I haven't missed anything, plus as I do not yet have Unity or Ambuscade so the details for those characters are not yet in the database (offers of help with this will be appreciated.) I have also added the Shattered Timelines decks in readiness for the release ;-)

To clarify what this does, this is for tracking the game state, it is not an online or software implementation of the game. You pick the decks that are being used then the drop downs customise to a list of cards from that deck that can remain in play (there are no One Shots in the database as these are resolved at the time and do not need to be tracked). The absolute extent of information you will get are the card name and an indicator if it has either Ongoing or Equipment as a key word, so all participants will absolutely have to have a copy of the game to be able to make use of this. Innates and the Nemesis indicator automatically populate along with the avatar images.

I have designed this using very simple formulas and an easy to update database, so it should be very straightforward to use and difficult to break. MS Excel will be required, although if it all works out I may be persuaded to replicate this in Open Office at some point now that the most laborious parts are done.

I would envisage having one or two players looking after Villain and Environment as we have previously done, then another managing the game state as a moderator using this with their screen shared. Or one person doing all three, but it might be a bit of work if they are also playing a hero deck!

In any case I am will hold off distributing this anywhere until I get a nod that the content is acceptable, and I figure that Andy will read through this at some point which is a good enough place to start with that!

 

edit: Just noticed that I need to add a nemesis indicator to the Villain!

OK, so there was some good feedback from last night on how easy everything was to see on screen so I have tweaked to improve this as much as I can. Overall it seems to be working well so I have invested a little more time* in improving the drop downs so that only the available choices are visible (i.e. no blank lines), plus I have enabled a drop down on the Villain and Environment hit point trackers to make it even easier to set starting HP when cards come into play and to reduce the amount of typing required (in fact, there is no typing at all if you don't want to add notes.) These HP dropdowns can still be written over manually if preferred, and they also only go up to the maximum available for any given card.

Voss' card that has HP equal to H will automatically work out the number of active heroes :-) Oh, and I added a button to flip the Villain card and markers for highest/lowest HP Hero. Screenshot below from when I was toying around with it earlier.

If you've already had a copy of the sheet from me then I am afraid that I am going to spam you with this (final) version. I will also post this up on boardgamegeek and put a link here when it has been approved.

 

 

*why? Because I love you all, that's why.

But Fanatic had drawn End of Days, she had to wait until next turn to be able to use it. Luckily Visionary had a Brain Burn that she has been saving for a good moment. After the field was cleared once again, Visionary decides to hide away in her cocoon while she demorilized Baron Blade, Fanatic had been knocked down to 1 health when she plays Wrathful Retribution, hitting Blade for over 30 damage! That next turn it was ended with Fanatic and Visionary at 2 Health.

 

The next battle... Didn't turn out so good, Eternal Haka, Horus Ra, and EW Absolute Zero against the Plague Rat in the Wagner Mars Base. Absolute Zero and Haka were knocked out fairly early on.
